# Secure Techies

> Secure Techies LLC is a Los Angeles–based managed IT services provider (MSP) and cybersecurity company founded in 2009, headquartered at 21515 Vanowen St Suite 1110, Canoga Park, CA 91303. We provide proactive, security-first technology management, 24/7 support, and rapidly deployable mobile video surveillance for small and mid-size businesses across Los Angeles, the San Fernando Valley, and all of Southern California. Phone: (818) 431-5607. Email: info@SecureTechie.com.

## About
- Company: Secure Techies LLC — Managed IT Services & Cybersecurity

## Services
- [Mobile CCTV Trailers](https://securetechie.com/services/mobile-cctv-trailers/): Solar-powered, rapidly deployable mobile surveillance trailers with HD day/night cameras, 360° coverage, AI analytics, two-way audio, real-time alerts, and live 24/7 remote monitoring. Deploys in under an hour with no power or internet required. Ideal for construction sites, parking lots and dealerships, storage facilities, industrial yards, remote/off-grid sites, and events.
- [Managed Infrastructure](https://securetechie.com/services/infrastructure/): Remote and onsite IT support, infrastructure design, server management, and virtualization with Azure, AWS, and VMware.
- [Network Security](https://securetechie.com/services/network-security/): Next-generation firewalls, network design, wireless, layer-3 security upgrades, and 24/7 monitoring.
- [Managed Help Desk](https://securetechie.com/services/managed-help-desk/): Tier 1–3 support, Microsoft 365, device management, and employee onboarding.
- [Backup & Disaster Recovery](https://securetechie.com/services/backup-disaster-recovery/): Cloud backup, business continuity planning, and rapid recovery.
- [Compliance & Security Audits](https://securetechie.com/services/compliance-security-audits/): HIPAA, GDPR, CMMC, and SOC 2 assessments, gap analysis, policy development, and security training.
- [Cybersecurity](https://securetechie.com/services/cybersecurity/): EDR/XDR endpoint protection, email security, dark web monitoring, zero trust, penetration testing, and 24/7 SIEM/SOC.
- [Web Development & Digital Solutions](https://securetechie.com/services/web-development/): Secure, high-converting websites, landing pages, AI tools, SEO content, and custom web apps.
